audit.description: Enable Linux audit logging (if compiled-in); only presence matters, no value required

audit.enabled.description: If true, enable audit logging via DBUS_BROKER_AUDIT=1

controller_fd.description: File descriptor number for the controller socket (required)

log_fd.description: Optional file descriptor number for logging output (defaults to no logging if omitted)

machine_id.description: Machine ID (typically from /etc/machine-id); required for bus identity

max_bytes.description: Maximum bytes each user may allocate in the broker (default: 16 MiB)

max_fds.description: Maximum file descriptors each user may allocate in the broker (default: 64)

max_matches.description: Maximum match rules each user may allocate in the broker (default: 16k)

max_objects.description: Maximum objects (names, peers, etc.) each user may allocate (default: 16k)
